opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

amount.raw: up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership (not required for all group members). Groups of 8-15 individuals with a diverse mix of career stages, institutions, genders, ethnicities and international participation, not formed entirely of academic institutions.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by funding the formation of new two-year synthesis groups that bring together diverse interdisciplinary groups to analyse and synthesise existing data.

opportunities.title: Long-term research grants

amount.raw: up to £500 per year for a decade; first five years' funding (£3,500) claimable in year 1, additional £3,500 in year 6

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners, reserve managers and consultants, as well as university academics. Awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Provides a small amount of funding each year for 10 years to enable existing short-term projects with 1-2 years of data to be funded into the long term, supporting long-term ecological studies anywhere in the world.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical research and development grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level (early years to lifelong learning, formal or informal settings), including those in industry. Awarded to individuals, not organisations. Projects max 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Funds research informing teaching and learning practices that improve learners' experience and promote excellence in teaching, developing evidence to inform ecological education.

opportunities.title: Connecting ecologists with other disciplines grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations. Undergraduates and masters students not eligible. Awarded to individuals, not organisations. Placements up to 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Promotes interdisciplinary skills by funding placements (secondments) that immerse an ecologist in another professional world (another discipline, NGO/charity, public sector, business) to solve common problems using an interdisciplinary approach.

opportunities.title: Small research grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Provides funding for researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world. Not a scholarship; does not cover principal researcher salary, bench fees or departmental vehicle hire.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard, with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Outreach and engagement grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership. Open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels to organise ecological public engagement events. Projects max 12 months. No restrictions on where applicants come from or carry out work.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for individuals, teams and organisations to engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science through outreach, public engagement and science communication activities.

opportunities.title: Training and travel grants

amount.raw: maximum £500 for in-person events, maximum £250 for virtual conferences/courses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member and a PhD student or postgraduate researcher (postdocs, undergraduates and masters students not eligible). Must work/study at a university or research institution and work in scientific areas within the BES remit.
opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and to present their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member at any career stage, a citizen of and based in the Global South, travelling from and returning to that country, and must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting. Must be at least three years since last BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK, covering travel, registration, food and accommodation costs.
